summary: San Francisco Bay Area, UNIX SysAdmin, self-taught, VPS hosting entrepreneur, strong technical background, experience in hiring and mentoring junior technical staff, prefers command-line interfaces, values open-source software, critical of marketing practices, believes in providing objective value over perceived value, operates a small hosting company (prgmr.com), focuses on low-cost, high-RAM server solutions, advocates for off-site backups and redundancy, has a history of working in tech since the .com boom, prefers to hire underemployed or inexperienced individuals, values personal credibility and transparency in business, has a strong interest in technology and infrastructure, has a critical view of corporate practices and investor relationships, enjoys problem-solving and technical challenges, has a history of working with various operating systems including FreeBSD and Linux, has experience with server hardware assembly and maintenance, believes in the importance of community and networking within the tech industry.
